$comment: vacuous-check policy — the ratchet + allowlist contract for scripts/gate_vacuous_check.py
A per-entry `reason` + `owner`, and — critically — a MISSING policy file is NOT
'no policy configured, skip'. The gate treats absence as {mode: "fail", allowlist: []},
the strictest posture there is. Only editing THIS file down to mode:"fail" (or an empty
allowlist) retires an entry; deleting the file cannot silence the gate.
PRE-EMPTIVE: this repo's harden-gate.yml is canonical-stamped (shared verbatim across all
hardened repos per its own header comment), so gate-vacuous-check has not landed here yet —
it arrives via FuzeSDLC's governance-sync once izzywdev/FuzeSDLC#191 merges. This file is
written now so the gate does not immediately red this repo the day it arrives; every entry
below was individually verified (not guessed) at the time this file was written.
mode:"ramp"  — allowlist entries below suppress their named finding. New violations not
mode:"fail"  — the allowlist is INERT regardless of its contents; every finding fails.
Flipping to this is how an entry is proven fully retired.

allowlist.reason: Verified 2026-08-23: 143 real mypy errors across 29 files in services/orchestrator (attr-defined, arg-type, var-annotated — real type mismatches, not just missing annotations), plus a module-resolution config issue in a2a_protocol.py. Backend-engineer scope to fix; not a CI-wiring change.
pytest-benchmark performance tests are perf-tracking, not a correctness gate. Whether a perf regression should ever block a merge is a product decision this CI-wiring pass does not make.
Same 143 real mypy findings as test.yml's lint job (see that entry) — ci.yml's lint-and-test-backend job checks the identical services/orchestrator codebase.

This job has no Postgres/Redis service containers (unlike test.yml's test-backend job, which does), so an unfiltered pytest run here fails on missing infra, not on code. Duplicates test.yml's test-backend job; real fix is consolidating the two workflows, which is a bigger structural change than this PR's CI-wiring scope.

Not independently reverifiable in a CI-wiring pass: needs a docker daemon and a private-registry GITHUB_TOKEN secret to build fuzeagent-ui. Needs whoever can actually run it to confirm current findings are clean or add a justified per-CVE ignore list.

Verified 2026-08-23: 23 current advisories (16 high, 3 critical) in services/ui-react devDependencies (vite/vitest/ws transitive chain). `npm audit fix` covers most, but bumping vite/vitest majors is a real dependency-upgrade decision with build-breakage risk, not a mechanical CI-wiring change.
